notes: Real INSEE MOBPRO 2021 commune-to-commune home-to-work flow totals are used directly (same source and commune pairs as our mainland France maps). No official fine-grained population/employment grid exists for this overseas territory (no Filosofi-equivalent), so within each commune, residents and jobs are placed on a synthetic ~275m grid weighted by OpenStreetMap building floor area (capped at the 95th percentile so no single large building absorbs a whole district's population). Real INSEE commune-level population totals anchor the residential side. Special demand points (airport, university, hospital, port, cruise terminal, industrial zone) use real sourced figures (passenger traffic, enrollment, bed counts) rather than estimates.
